messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly Northline Care check-in. How are you feeling this week? If you have a blood pressure reading handy, share it and we'll go from there.
Not good at all. Just checked and it was 178/112. Got this pounding headache since this morning, both temples. It's not letting up.
Logging that reading now. Before anything else — did you take your blood pressure medication today?
Yeah, took it at 7 like always. Honestly the headache feels worse than when I woke up, not better.

Logged that you took your medication this morning. A reading of 178/112 paired with a worsening headache is something I have to escalate to a nurse — that's beyond what I'm able to assess. I've sent the flag. Median response time is currently 31 hours. I want to be direct: if your headache gets suddenly much worse, or you notice vision changes, chest pain, or trouble speaking, don't wait for the nurse — call 911 or have someone take you in.
31 hours is a long time when my head feels like this. Can you do anything to move it faster, or get someone to drive me somewhere?

I can't bump your place in the queue or arrange transportation — I'm not able to do either of those things, and I won't tell you otherwise. The escalation is in the system and a nurse will see it. If you feel like you can't wait, calling 911 is the right move and you don't have to wait on us to do that.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
